sembench.upstream_dependency_profile: 1.1.3; not used as the execution profile

input.selection: Entire fixed 2000-row execution CSV, in source order; no quality-driven selection
input.provenance_limit: Execution CSV and upstream CSV differ in 360 rows. Q3 eligible full rows and source positions are equal. Do not extend this equality to Q1/Q2 or the entire dataset.
input.offline_projection: records.csv without scoreSentiment; references.csv retained separately; projection cost reported separately

method.instruction: Determine if the following review is clearly positive. Review: {reviewText}

model.cache_policy: LOTUS result cache disabled; fresh model owners in this first cold experiment; capture effective vLLM prefix/cache/compile defaults and package hashes before running

shared_resources.scope: Proposed common ceilings; require current runtime inventory and per-owner monitoring, not a claim of cgroup enforcement
shared_resources.foreign_process_action: stop queue; never kill foreign owners or reset old ledgers
shared_resources.native_concurrency: Per-backend native limits, not a shared SemLoom scheduling policy

design.measured_order: Five cyclic Latin rotations: each backend occurs once at each position
design.selection: Choose lower cold complete-query wall time among correctness/quality/resource-valid calibration points; exact tie selects profile p1; freeze before measured block 1
design.cold_scope: Fresh query and model owner; native graph/process construction and model load remain in query/CLI cost where they occur
design.resident_scope: Unavailable in this first cold matrix; do not infer resident performance from repeated cold CLIs or remove native in-query reconstruction
design.time_estimate: Uncalibrated planning estimate 3-6 minutes per cold unit plus 15-30 minutes control: 120-240 minutes for 35 units; replace only before budget approval with observed matching-profile calibration

timing.primary: t_complete_result - t_query_submit, starting before query-scoped source validation/read and backend construction; ending after native complete COUNT/result delivery, before offline evaluation
timing.cold_application: Outer monotonic time from driver start through durable result and owned process/GPU cleanup, including runtime and all query-scoped model startup
timing.existing_query_seconds: Diagnostic only: existing qualification runner starts after driver preflight/expected and runtime init; not interchangeable with the primary boundary
timing.overlap: Do not sum nested or parallel phase times or subtract process CPU from wall time

quality.original_metric: Unmodified original Movie Q3 COUNT evaluator, gold count 14 for the fixed input
quality.execution_gate: Exactly 120 unique successful terminal calls with valid usage, original parser and full COUNT; any failed/unknown/missing/duplicate or unresolved resource responsibility stops the cell
quality.comparison_gate: Same fixed response CPU parity first; real native baseline and every arm must then retain exact effective messages/generation and row-decision/COUNT equality for an execution-only comparison. Original accuracy and row errors are reported even when all arms agree.
quality.mismatch: Preserve raw quality and cost results; report quality-incomparable rather than attributing performance to scheduling; no prompt/threshold tuning to force success

statistics.independent_unit: One complete query/owner invocation; same model seed and shared machine may induce dependence, so show all paired blocks and observed conditions
primary_reports: rows/s and successful model calls/s with exact boundary
statistics.p99: unavailable: five complete-query samples per backend
statistics.p99_99: unavailable: five complete-query samples per backend
statistics.tail_sufficiency: At n=5, even P(at least one beyond true p99)=1-.99^5 is only about4.9%; for p99.99 about0.05%. Approximately299/29956 independent samples give only95% chance of one tail observation, not a reliable quantile estimate. Request latencies within one batch/query do not enlarge independent query n.

formal_gates: Parent approves a fresh formal call/time budget and immutable per-query reservations; preparation is not authorization
Integrator freezes final source and reviews this package; old source-bound results do not qualify the final source/profile
Native LOTUS adapter retaining original LM batch_completion scheduling is CPU implemented; actual current-source vLLM HTTP/token/model-quality and physical-exit qualification still required.
IMLane original author FilterScope plus Q3 COUNT/evaluator adapter is CPU implemented; actual current author ABI/model/template and physical exit still require engineering qualification.
Common result-ready observer, cold application clock and supervisor monitoring are implemented; final combined CPU checks and Linux process/resource inventory still required.
Current environment/model/weights/tokenizer/template/engine-default/CPU-GPU allocation signatures and all exit/resource monitors must pass
Two finite native calibration opportunities per arm finish within the new ledger; selected profiles frozen before measurement
excluded: Movie Q1/Q2 and Q4-Q10, Animals and other original queries: no current matched records task/evaluator qualification
Map/Extract chains as substitutes for unsupported original SemBench queries
Global helper cascade: engineering helper/logprobs/role-lifecycle qualification pending; no helper calls budgeted here
Async Core candidate, adaptive strategy, multi-GPU, IMLane author Ray runtime, fused Daft alternate layouts, images and multimodal tasks
No-Core static-reference wrapper: optional separate internal control, not the production Core arm and not funded in these five arms
Old request four-arm three-query 35840-call template and historical model ledgers
source_scope: source_commit is the production-compatible preparation base. Final combined executable source is separately bound by source.lock.json and the preparation package checked_out_commit.
